meta.counts_blurb: Average bikes per day from Leeds City Council automatic counters (12 months to the latest data where available) and the busiest DfT traffic count points inside West Yorkshire, 2021–25. Green dots are off-road paths. Leeds is the only council here with open data from automatic counters; most DfT counts are single weekday counts on main roads, so leisure riding is undercounted. Counters on one-way lanes count one direction only. Police collision data does not cover off-road paths, so they have usage figures but no safety rating.
